in_sanskrit.name: राखल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who protects Rakshasas, mythical beings in Hindu mythology.

in_hindi.name: राखल
in_hindi.meaning: राक्षस (Rakshas) + आल (aal) = राक्षसों (Rakshasas) का साधक (sadhak) या सेवक (sevak)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The devotee or servant of Rakshasas in Hindu mythology.

in_tamil.name: ராகல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The protector or caretaker of Rakshasas in Tamil mythology.

in_telugu.name: రాఖల్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the lord or master of Rakshasas in Telugu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Rakhal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rakhal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who protects and preserves. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raksha', meaning protection.

in_bengali.name: Rakhal
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rakhal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who protects and preserves. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raksha', meaning protection.
